ui.offHint: This effect is off and not heard. Turn it on, or just change a value.

panel.title: Effects
panel.masterOnly: Only available on the Master output
panel.editingTrack: Editing track "{{name}}". Choose Master to edit the mixed output.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Gain, loudness normalization and a safety limiter. Applied last in the effect chain.
volume.gainHint: Amplification in decibels. +6 dB doubles the amplitude, -6 dB halves it. Double-click to reset.
volume.normalizeHint: Peak: scales so the loudest sample hits the target (dBFS). LUFS: matches perceived loudness (EBU R128).
volume.peakTargetHint: Level of the loudest sample after normalizing, in dBFS (0 = full scale). -1 dBFS leaves headroom for lossy encoders.
volume.lufsTargetHint: Integrated loudness after normalizing. Typical: -14 LUFS (streaming/mobile), -16 LUFS (podcast), -23 LUFS (broadcast).
volume.limiterHint: Prevents the signal from ever exceeding the ceiling (no clipping).
volume.ceilingHint: Maximum output level in dB true peak.
volume.releaseHint: How fast the limiter recovers after reducing a peak. Short = louder but may pump, long = smoother.

pitchTempo.title: Pitch & Tempo
pitchTempo.description: Change pitch (semitones + cents) and speed independently, or together like a tape.
pitchTempo.tempoHint: Playback speed in percent. 50 % = twice as long, 200 % = half as long.

modeHint.stretch: Time-stretch: tempo changes the length only, pitch stays the same (pitch is set by semitones/cents).
modeHint.varispeed: Tape-style: tempo changes both speed and pitch together (faster = higher), semitones/cents are added on top.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: High-pass, low-pass, band-pass, notch and shelving filters. Bands are applied in order.
filters.empty: No filter yet. Click "Add filter" (e.g. a high-pass at 80 Hz removes rumble).

typeHints.highpass: Removes frequencies below the cutoff (rumble, wind, hum).
typeHints.lowpass: Removes frequencies above the cutoff (hiss, harshness).
typeHints.bandpass: Keeps only a band around the center frequency.
typeHints.notch: Cuts a narrow band (e.g. 50/60 Hz hum).
typeHints.lowshelf: Boosts or cuts everything below the frequency.
typeHints.highshelf: Boosts or cuts everything above the frequency.

filters.freqHint: Cutoff / center frequency (logarithmic). You can type values like 2.5k.
filters.qHint: Resonance / bandwidth. 0.707 = flat (Butterworth); higher = narrower and more resonant.
filters.qFixedHint: With 24/48 dB/oct the filter uses Butterworth sections, so Q is fixed.
filters.slopeHint: Steepness of the filter: 12 dB/oct is gentle, 48 dB/oct is very steep.
filters.gainHint: Boost or cut of the shelf in dB.

eq.title: Equalizer (16 bands)
eq.description: 16-band graphic equalizer, ±18 dB per band. Click a fader to edit its Q. The colored area is the output spectrum.

denoise.title: Noise reduction
denoise.description: Removes steady background noise (hiss, hum, fans). Learn a noise profile from a noise-only selection for best results.

modeHint.spectral: General purpose: works on any material, uses the noise profile and all parameters below.
modeHint.rnnoise: Neural network tuned for speech. Best for dialogue and voice-overs; Reduction controls the strength.

denoise.reductionHint: How much the noise is attenuated. Too much can sound watery.
denoise.sensitivityHint: How far above the noise floor a sound must be to be kept. Higher removes more but may eat quiet details.
denoise.smoothingHint: Smooths the gain across neighbouring frequencies to avoid 'musical noise' artifacts.
denoise.profileHint: Select a part that contains only noise on the timeline, then click Learn.
denoise.needSelection: Select a noise-only region on the timeline first.

loop.title: Seamless loop
loop.description: Joins the end to the beginning with a crossfade so the sound loops without a click.
loop.crossfadeHint: Length of the overlap between the tail and the head. The output gets shorter by this amount.
loop.curveHint: Equal power keeps constant loudness for uncorrelated material (music, ambience); linear suits identical material.
loop.regionHint: Part of the mix used for the loop. Select a region on the timeline and click "Use selection".
loop.zeroCrossingHint: Moves the loop points to the nearest zero crossing to avoid clicks.
loop.matchLoudnessHint: Evens out the level of the start and end so the seam is not audible.
loop.hint: Tip: enable Loop playback in the transport bar to listen to the seam repeatedly.

optimize.presetsDescription: One click sets format, sample rate, channels and quality for common game-audio uses.

sfxMobile.name: SFX mobile
sfxMobile.detail: OGG · 22.05 kHz · mono · q0.4 · trim silence

optimize.outputDescription: These settings are used by Export. Lower sample rate, mono and lossy formats make files much smaller.
optimize.previewHint: Plays and displays the audio exactly as it will be exported (resampled, downmixed, encoded).
optimize.noAudio: Add audio to see size estimates.

trimSilence.title: Trim silence
trimSilence.description: Removes silence at the start and end of the output (smaller files, tighter SFX timing).
trimSilence.thresholdHint: Anything quieter than this level counts as silence.
trimSilence.padHint: Silence kept before the first and after the last sound.
